prompt: Animate the supplied image with extremely restrained, continuous ambient motion while preserving the exact composition, framing, colours and lighting. Camera locked on a tripod: zero orbit, dolly, pan, zoom, shake or focus pull. The ribbon of floating candles bobs very slowly and the flames flicker softly; faint stars twinkle in the tall windows. The dark hall on the left stays dark and still; the ribbon of candles keeps its exact curving path and shape; no new candles or lights appear. One uninterrupted shot. Every moving element completes exactly one slow, even cycle and eases back to its original shape, so the first and last frames are identical. No cuts, flashes, lightning, bursts, sparkles toward the camera, whole-frame flicker or exposure change; nothing flickers faster than twice a second. No people, figures, riders, faces, hands, text, letters, symbols, logos or new objects appear. No audio.

retakeIfWanted.why: B1 diagnosis: "extremely restrained" + "one slow, even cycle" + a pinned end let Kling freeze calm plates. Name one visible primary motion and ask for it continuously.
retakeIfWanted.prompt: Animate the supplied image with gentle but clearly visible, continuous motion in the candle flames, while preserving the exact composition, framing, colours and lighting. Camera locked on a tripod: zero orbit, dolly, pan, zoom, shake or focus pull. Every candle flame along the floating ribbon flickers and sways softly and continuously, each out of step with its neighbours, and the large candles in the foreground flicker gently; their warm reflections on the polished floor shimmer; a few faint stars in the tall windows twinkle slowly. The ribbon of candles keeps its exact curving path and every candle stays in place; the dark hall on the left stays dark and still; no new candles or lights appear. One uninterrupted shot; the flames keep flickering all the way through, and the first and last frames match the supplied image. No cuts, flashes, lightning, bursts, sparkles toward the camera, whole-frame flicker or exposure change; no flame flickers faster than twice a second and the overall glow varies by no more than about fifteen percent. No people, figures, riders, faces, hands, text, letters, symbols, logos or new objects appear. No audio.
